description: List the account's HyperExecute jobs, newest first, with offset pagination and an optional status filter. The status filter looks at the 200 most recent jobs.

limit.description: Maximum number of jobs to return, 1 to 200 (default 10)

offset.description: Number of jobs to skip, after the status filter (default 0)

status.description: Only jobs with this status (e.g. completed, failed, running, skipped), among the 200 most recent

name: listHyperExecuteJobs
title: List HyperExecute Jobs
